notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
This patch mostly consists of bug fixes but we do have full left handed support now! Left hand controls can now be accessed via the options menu. Let us know how they feel or if they should be moved around a bit.

Other bugs addressed in this patch include:
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements bug. You can no longer earn certain pacifist run achievements by simply quitting the level. So you will have to actually earn them now.
[*] Fixed the typos! Not really a bug just poor grammar on our part.
[*] You can no longer control enemies with the arrow keys on certain levels.
[*] Fixed some doors that were not working.
[*] General visual and layering edits. 
[/list]
Let us know if you find any more and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Shot in the Dark is a clever tough platformer where enemies blend into the background
notes.content:
Shot in the Dark needs you to have good platforming skills, good point and click aiming skills and it's a whole lot of fun if you're up for the challenge.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/01/shot-in-the-dark-is-a-clever-tough-platformer-where-enemies-blend-into-the-background

notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content:
It has been a long time coming but Shot in the Dark is finally here! You can grab it this week for 20% off!

We are super proud of this dark and twisted little game and we hope you enjoy getting lost in the dark!

We are looking forward to all your speed runs and hope you don’t get too frustrated…. >_>’

From everyone here at Possum House, thank you for your continued support and keep on gaming!

[previewyoutube=Wfb8XGpAkHY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Launch Date Announcement!
notes.content:
We're glad to announce that we finally have a set launch date!

Shot in the Dark will be launching on January 12, 2021!

Soon you'll be able to pick up your six shooter and make your way through the hoards of unholy creatures to collect your bounty. 

Thanks to all of you lovely players who've played the demo so far and we're excited to get the game in your hands. 

[previewyoutube=NZ5BnQpFTmM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: We have a projected launch date!
notes.content:
At long last, after fixing the last few bugs, adding the last few quality of life features, and fixing the new bugs we added with the new features, we can finally let you all know.

The game will be released in Q1 2021! 

That's right, not that much longer now! Stay tuned for a launch date announcement in the coming weeks.

We are excited to get the game to you all and want to thank you all for your patience so far!
